t: The Organization page shows who reports to whom, your departments, and a directory of everyone.
In this video, you will learn how to move around the chart, see a person's profile, use the directory and departments, and edit the organization.
To open this page, click Org in the left menu.
The chart shows everyone, from the top. Drag to move around, and zoom with the mouse wheel or the plus and minus buttons.
Click a person to see their profile on the right: title, department, manager and direct reports.
Filter by department, or show only people online now.
Directory lists everyone in a table you can search and sort.
Departments shows each department, its head and its people.
Insights points out things that need a look, like people with no manager.
Admins press Edit person to set a job title, department, manager and phone.
You can also drag a person onto their new manager in the chart. Import CSV adds many people at once from a spreadsheet.
That completes the Organization chart page.
Next in the Work menu: Decisions.
